## Configuration and preset updates

- App defaults, H.264 bitrate targets, codec rate ratios, and the buffer multiplier are read from `config.ini`; bitrate targets are shared H.264 baselines and are scaled for the selected encoder codec and bit depth.
- Removed duplicate app-wide bitrate and buffer definitions from `presets.ini`. Presets retain intentional quality, speed, profile, and advanced-setting differences.
- Added numeric version tags to both INI files. Startup downloads and installs a remote file only when its version tag is newer, while preserving the saved hardware capability cache.
- GPU capability checks are reused until the detected driver version changes. NVIDIA decode prefers available CUVID/NVDEC decoders.

## Encoding workflow

- Video stream language can be assigned during encoding.
- Editing Max Rate switches to a custom configuration and keeps buffer size at three times Max Rate until the user edits the buffer manually.
- Batch encoding taskbar progress reports overall queue progress; rsgain progress is normalized for the app progress display.
- Stable Jellyfin FFmpeg is used by default when stable and prerelease releases share the same major/minor version. The prerelease option appears when its major/minor is newer.

## Required update

- Versions below 2.9.0 must update before continuing.
